summary: Vista Energy repurchased 50,000 Series A shares at MXN 1,161.63 per share, total ~MXN 58.08 million, on July 29, 2026, authorized by the April 28, 2026 shareholders' meeting. After repurchase, 111,217,402 shares remain outstanding and 1,084,351 are held in treasury. Citi México Casa de Bolsa executed the buyback. This is an issuer tender under a share repurchase program, a capital-return event. Watch ongoing buyback pace and treasury accumulation for potential cancellation or future capital returns.
